Don't go into GPS at any cost and stay away from any US state projects. Other service lines are far better in terms of tech, growth and opportunities.

reviews.pros: Deloitte, as an organisation tries to take care of employees well-being. I believe they are offering good hikes compared to what’s happening in the market now.
reviews.cons: Management is literally the worst. Just when you think they can’t go even lower than this, they will. Maybe that’s just our managements mentality. They are micro, nano managing at this point and are bad mouthing team members with other teams

reviews.pros: People are nice, helpful and understanding. They support you when needed. Culture is great. All resources are available for knowledge and development. Leaders are very nice, humble and supportive.
reviews.cons: Nothing
